what_it_does: HyperHammer demonstrates a hardware vulnerability attack that breaks through cloud virtualization defenses to compromise the hypervisor (the software that manages virtual machines). The attack exploits physical memory bit errors caused by repeated electrical disturbances. Previous attacks targeted virtual machines running on hypervisors, but this work shows how to attack the hypervisor itself by bypassing its built-in protections, potentially compromising all virtual machines on an entire cloud server.
